text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Cerulean Energy usage dropped ~82% in the last 7 days, new procurement lead (Tracy) just came in and we've heard they're running a quick pilot with Northwind AI. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Can we triage quickly and get a short exec sync? I uploaded the week-over-week snapshot to the account folder.

josh_csm: Thanks Maria. Can you DM an intro to Tracy? Is our champion Andre still engaged? If so I'll ask for a 15-30m slot this week. I'll prep a short ROI + risk summary. @paige_se can you join for technical Qs? :white_check_mark:

paige_se: I can join. Need API call volume, model-variant breakdown, and any 429/5xx spikes. If they're testing a competitor we should confirm whether their decision is latency/cost or stability. Also send a couple of representative queries so I can repro locally.

ken-engineer: Pulling logs now. Quick find: burst of 502s from 2024-11-03 11:20-11:40 in prod-west that aligns with the usage drop. Snippet: 
```
ERROR 11:23:02 upstream timeout model v2-infer
502 from rt-proxy on instance gpu-3
```
Possible deploy overlap + autoscaler thrash — could push users to try a different vendor. I'll surface the full 48h trace.

maria_cs: Andre replied — he's still the champion but stretched thin. Tracy (procurement) wants pricing + SLA proof points before buying back in. Andre is open to a 30-min sync if we include infra/ops. He suggested Friday 10am PT.

paige_se: I'll prepare a two-slide latency/cost snapshot and a short demo of our prefix/KV cache + Warm Start settings. Also will prep a one-pager on Dedicated pools (SLA, isolation, failover routing).

josh_csm: I'll send an agenda to Andre+Tracy. Action items: (1) Ken: export 48h API error/latency matrix and link here, (2) Paige: slides + demo env, (3) Maria: intro + confirm invite. I'll own post-call follow-ups and the CS playbook.

devops-bot: Billing alert: monthly token consumption down 78%; config change detected: warm-cache trial disabled on 2024-11-02 03:44 UTC.

maria_cs: Recap for thread — meeting Friday 10am PT. Ken please post the log link here. @josh_csm can you add the proposed agenda to the calendar invite? We'll propose a conditional offer: 3-month discounted Dedicated trial (SLA-backed) for the pilot if they commit to a QBR and a short success metric set.

josh_csm: Agenda posted to invite: 1) root-cause review (logs + metrics) 2) short-term mitigations (cache, routing, quick config) 3) Dedicated trial terms + SLA 4) success metrics & next steps. Also flagging competitive intel: Northwind claims lower latency at high concurrency — Paige/ken please prepare a trace/latency comparison.

maria_cs: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll confirm attendees and update after the call. :pray:
